Basic Requirement: Applicants must have IT-related experience demonstrating the following competencies appropriate to, or above, the level of this position. Attention to Detail- experience reviewing my own information technology-related work or data and have been asked by others to review their work or data to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency with standards.

Customer Service- experience maintaining relationships with customers, assessing current information technology needs of customers, and developing or identifying information technology products and services that are tailored to meet customer needs.

Oral Communication- briefing mid-level management and IT staff on the status of information technology systems, projects, or daily operations, including the communication of technical information to a non-technical audience.

Volunteer Experience: Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual, community, student, social).

IDAGIO is the leading streaming service for classical music, based in Berlin and part of IDAGIO Group. The Group spans streaming, recordings, and live music partnerships, globally. Our director initiates projects across all of it: recording partnerships with orchestras, licensing talks with international labels, concert-hall collaborations in Taiwan and Japan, and new ventures.
These initiatives move fast and span many time zones. We are looking for the person at the director's side who keeps them all on track.
Tasks
You are the assistant to the sole director of IDAGIO Group and work with him daily. He travels extensively and meets industry leaders, orchestras, and institutions across Asia, Europe and the US. Every trip produces introductions, ideas, and commitments. Your job is to make sure none of them get lost. You track every thread, follow up with every party, and hold everyone to agreed deadlines, including the director.
Beyond that, you coordinate selected projects across the Group's Berlin companies, working with their Managing Directors. Decisions sit with the director and the Managing Directors. Keeping things moving sits with you.
Assistant and project support to the director
Track and follow up on the projects and partnerships the director runs across the Group. You keep an up-to-date overview of status, owners, and next steps at all times.
Maintain deadlines and flag slipping dates early. You chase open items without being asked.
Prepare agendas, briefings, and follow-ups for meetings. Maintain trackers and status summaries.
Coordinate scheduling, information flow, and documentation across internal and external stakeholders, from orchestra managements to distribution partners.
Project coordination for Moto Lab
Moto Lab Partners is the Group's newest venture: it supports classical artists and institutions in building their international presence and careers, from recordings and concert videos to release strategy and promotion.
Coordinate Moto Lab's projects from start to finish, whatever their shape: a release, a concert video production, a marketing campaign, or a partner engagement.
Act as the central point of contact between everyone involved: artists and their management, orchestras, production crews, distributors, agencies, and internal teams.
Track each project's timeline from planning through delivery, follow up on deliverables, and support project and budget administration until everything is complete and approved.

Several years of professional experience, typically 2 to 5, in an assistant, coordination, project management, or artist management role. This should not be your first job. You have managed deadlines across multiple stakeholders and worked alongside a demanding senior principal before.
A firm understanding of classical music and the industry around it: repertoire, orchestras, how recordings and releases work. A background in classical music (studies, an orchestra, a label, an agency, a concert hall) is a strong plus.
Proactive and organized by temperament. You take ownership, chase without being prompted, and flag problems early.
Comfortable running several projects in parallel and prioritizing against deadlines.
Clear, structured communication and documentation. Status is transparent to everyone at any time.
Fluent German and English (C1 or better, spoken and written). Japanese or Mandarin is a real plus given our partners in Japan and Taiwan.
Based in Berlin or willing to relocate. Occasional flexibility for calls with Asia or the US and for concert or recording dates in the evening.

A rare vantage point: you work directly with the director of a music group active between Europe and Asia, and you see every initiative across it.
Real responsibility from day one. The role exists because these projects matter and need an owner.
A small, senior, international team in Berlin with short decision paths.
Salary range: €42,000–50,000 gross/year, depending on experience.
Send a short cover note, your CV, and your earliest possible start date to apply. Tell us about one person or project you supported where your follow-through made the difference.
IDAGIO and the IDAGIO Group value diversity. We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet 100% of the requirements.

Our client is an international luxury group undergoing significant international expansion, with a growing presence across key global markets.
To support the next phase of its development, the Group is seeking to strengthen its global People & Culture capabilities through the appointment of a highly analytical, business-oriented professional able to contribute to strategic workforce decisions, reward frameworks, and international talent initiatives.
This role offers a unique opportunity to operate at the intersection of people strategy, organisational effectiveness, workforce planning, and talent programs within a dynamic and globally connected environment.
## Job Description ##
We are looking for an International Rewards & Benefits Manager who will partner with different stakeholders across regions to support the evolution of people-related practices that enable business growth, organisational performance, and talent retention. This is a newly created role.
The successful candidate will combine strong analytical capability with commercial awareness, stakeholder management skills, and a genuine interest in contributing to the development of a modern and high-performing global organisation.**People Reward Advisory**
* Contribute to the development and enhancement of reward and recognition frameworks that support business objectives and workforce engagement.
* Provide market insights and benchmarking analyses to support talent attraction, retention, and organisational competitiveness.
* Partner with People leaders and business stakeholders on workforce-related decision making.
* Support the evaluation of workforce investments through data-driven recommendations and business analysis.
* Contribute to the ongoing evolution of the employee value proposition across international markets.
* Deliver insights and recommendations on workforce trends, organisational effectiveness, and talent sustainability.
**Workforce Planning**
* Support workforce planning initiatives across multiple regions and business functions.
* Develop and maintain reporting tools, dashboards, and workforce metrics to support leadership decision making.
* Analyse workforce trends, organisational data, employee movements, and retention indicators.
* Identify opportunities to improve workforce effectiveness and organisational performance.
* Provide meaningful people insights to support business planning and growth initiatives.
**Global Talent Initiatives**
* Support programmes facilitating the deployment and development of talent across international markets.
* Collaborate with regional stakeholders to ensure a consistent employee experience across the organisation.
* Participate in the development and enhancement of global people policies and frameworks.
* Contribute to initiatives designed to support employee engagement, talent development, and workforce sustainability.
* Coordinate with internal and external partners to support international people projects where required.
**Organisational Development & Transformation**
* Lead or contribute to strategic projects supporting organisational growth and transformation.
* Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to improve processes, governance, and operational effectiveness.
* Support the implementation of scalable people solutions across an international environment.
* Promote continuous improvement through data, innovation, and best practice sharing.
* Contribute to initiatives enhancing organisational agility and long-term workforce capability.
## The Successful Applicant ##
**Experience**
* Proven experience within Compensation & Benefits, Total Rewards, People Analytics, Talent, Mobilithy or related disciplines.
* Experience operating within complex, international, and multi-jurisdictional environments.
* Demonstrated ability to partner with senior stakeholders on business and workforce-related topics.
* Exposure to global organisations experiencing growth, transformation, or international expansion.
* Experience supporting or delivering cross-functional projects involving multiple regions and stakeholders.
**Skills**
* Strong analytical, numerical, and business acumen.
* Ability to transform data into strategic insights and practical recommendations.
* Excellent stakeholder management and influencing capabilities.
* Strong presentation and communication skills.
* Ability to navigate ambiguity and operate effectively within changing environments.
* Sound judgement, professionalism, and discretion.
**Personal Attributes**
* International mindset and cultural agility.
* Strategic thinker with a pragmatic approach to execution.
* Naturally collaborative and relationship-oriented.
* Curious, proactive, and solutions-focused.
* Comfortable challenging existing approaches constructively.
* Strong sense of ownership and accountability.
* Credible and confident when interacting with senior stakeholders.
## What's on Offer ##
This is an opportunity to join an ambitious international luxury group at an exciting stage of its global growth journey.
You will work closely with senior leaders across multiple markets and contribute to strategic initiatives that shape workforce decisions, organisational effectiveness, talent outcomes, and long-term business success.
The role offers broad exposure, international scope, and the opportunity to influence the future direction of a growing global organisation.

Dans le cadre de la coopération internationale, l'Office fédéral de la statistique s'engage en faveur du développement de systèmes de données et de statistiques durables. Les projets menés en Ouzbékistan et au Bangladesh favorisent l'échange d'expériences, le renforcement des capacités institutionnelles ainsi que l'élaboration de solutions dans les domaines des statistiques, de la gouvernance des données et de la gestion des données.
Par son engagement, l'OFS soutient la mise en œuvre de l'Agenda 2030 pour le développement durable et contribue notamment à renforcer les bases décisionnelles fondées sur des données en vue de la réalisation des objectifs de développement durable (ODD).

L'Office fédéral de la statistique (OFS) est le centre de compétences de la statistique publique et l'acteur principal de l'écosystème suisse des données.

Il produit des informations statistiques, œuvre pour l'harmonisation des données par le biais d'une gestion nationale des données et élabore des processus tirés de la science des données pour faire évoluer l'interprétation des données.

L'OFS contribue ainsi à la formation de l'opinion publique et apporte une contribution importante à la gouvernance démocratique moderne.

About Wolt
At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.
Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Every contact that reaches a customer support agent, and every credit issued to customers, represents a defect somewhere in our system. This role exists to help find those defects, trace them to their source, and work with the teams responsible to eliminate them at a systemic level.
This is a high impact senior program management role within the EMEA Customer Experience organisation, reporting to the Director of Defect Elimination and Customer Experience. The Senior Program Manager is accountable for turning customer experience signals from Wolt and/or Deliveroo markets into clear, actionable insight, and for driving the resulting fixes through to resolution with partner teams.
What you’ll be doing
You will own the delivery of the defect elimination program across EMEA, including application of the defect driver taxonomy to identify where defect rate concentrates, and where customer outcomes are worst. You will build a clear, prioritised list of issues for partner teams to work through.
You will represent the voice of the customer in the rooms where decisions get made about your markets. That means preparing and presenting data in product reviews, weekly/monthly business reviews and planning sessions, so the cost of poor customer experience is concrete and attributable, and so partner teams understand what is being asked of them and why.
You will build working relationships with partner teams in engineering, marketplace operations, courier operations, and finance, and you will track the fixes they commit to through to completion. You will feed results back into the program so everyone can see what worked, and to ensure defects are eliminated for good.
You will maintain and improve the data infrastructure and reporting that underpins this work, ensuring customer experience insights are credible, available and actionable.
Our humble expectations
The right person for this role has spent time inside a large-scale customer experience or operations function, and has direct experience translating customer defects through identification, root cause analysis and resolution. They are comfortable working with imperfect data, and they know how to build a credible case when the evidence is directional rather than conclusive.
Strong analytical instincts are essential. This person needs to know what questions to ask of the data and whether the answers make sense. Prior exposure to a successful voice of the customer (VoC) program is critical.
There is a meaningful cross-functional dimension to the role. This person will spend real time getting other teams to prioritise work that benefits the customer but may compete with other priorities. That requires good judgement, clear communication, and the ability to build trust quickly with people outside their reporting line.
The role also requires the ability to drive results in a dynamic and ambiguous landscape. The right person will combine introducing structure and rigor, while being agile and responsive to changing priorities and emerging issues.
This is a high impact and high visibility role, with the opportunity to interact with stakeholders and teams across the full customer lifecycle. The role will also span across 40 EMEA Roo & Wolt markets, meaning there is an opportunity to drive financial and customer experience results at scale.
Next steps
You will first meet with our Talent Acquisition team to understand role and company fit. Then, you will meet with the Hiring Manager who will talk through your relevant experience and ask you competency based questions that assess your suitability for the role.

The third stage is an assignment, where you will be given a business problem to think through, and present back to the team. If successful, there may be a final conversation with a more senior stakeholder. Throughout all stages, you will have plenty of opportunities to ask any questions about the role, team or company.
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Evaluates performance of subordinate supervisors and reviews evaluations made by supervisors of subordinate employee's performance. Establishing policy and provides management oversight of the State Data Reporting Systems Division responsible for the crash record-based data.

Crash record based data includes the Fatality Analysis Reporting System (FARS), a fundamental national data base on traffic safety, Crash Report Sampling System (CRSS), Not-in-Traffic System (NTS) and the State Electronic Data Collection Program (SEDC)., The Division also provides the expertise in sample design and quality control to the other offices in the National Center for Statistics and Analysis, the rest of NHTSA and other offices in DOT.

Establishing policy and provides management oversight of the Crash Investigation Division (CID), provides executive leadership in the planning, design, development, coordination, and management of national networks of motor vehicle traffic crash research and data collection activities.

Maintaining liaison with other Federal agencies, State and local governments, police agencies, hospitals, private safety groups, motor vehicle and equipment manufacturers, crash research and analysis organizations, professional societies, and other groups with an interest in crash investigation and crash data for the purposes are for exchanging crash data and information on crash research technology, encouraging the use of crash data, and cooperating on crash research programs.

The ideal candidate is a data executive and systems expert with a track record of managing federal data collection, automation, and national crash investigation programs.

A skilled collaborator, they excel at building partnerships across federal, state, and private sectors including law enforcement, public health, and the automotive industry to secure cooperation and advance data systems.

Furthermore, they bring expertise in data governance, enforcing quality control and data completeness while protecting individual privacy, ensuring the delivery of accurate databases that support national safety research and rulemaking.

Communication: Communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, including the ability to secure community support, build strategic intergovernmental alliances, and establish private-sector data-sharing partnerships.
